title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-011
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA source files and reports regarding the JAL flight 1628 UFO sighting and other Alaskan sightings, containing multiple firsthand accounts and investigative records.

encounters.summary: JAL flight 1628 crew observed unidentified air traffic with navigation and strobe lights, which they claimed moved in formation with their aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two spaceships and a mothership; lights described as amber, white, and yellow; mothership described as having numerous exhaust pipes and being larger than a B747.
encounters.entity_behavior: Moved in formation with the aircraft, stopped in front of the aircraft, and later disappeared.
encounters.location_name: Alaska, near Fairbanks and Fort Yukon
encounters.quote: We see irregular pulsating lights just there is a large black chunk just in front of us

encounters.summary: Alaska Airlines flight crew reported unidentified air traffic on their weather radar system.
encounters.quote: target on their radar moved at a very high rate of speed
